### The Promise to Isaac, Part 1
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/promise-isaac
Passage: Genesis 26:1-5
Points:
- Redemption encompasses physical realities—including life, land, and offspring—alongside spiritual promises.
- God reaffirmed His covenant with Abraham directly to Isaac, directing where he should live.
- The promise of "all these lands" anticipates the global inheritance believers receive through Christ.
- Children of believers cannot presume on ancestral faith; each individual must personally repent and trust God.
- Obedience does not earn salvation, but it proves the presence of true saving faith.
- The greatest blessing of the covenant is the Lord's personal presence dwelling with His people.
